role: Placement reference: every block-placing item (ItemBlock and subclasses, ItemReed, ItemDoor, ItemBed, ItemSign, ItemSeeds, ItemSeedFood, ItemSkull, ItemHoe, ItemRedstone, ItemEnderEye, cocoa dye) driven through ItemStack.tryPlaceItemIntoWorld on a raw region scattered with support blocks, with a posed survival placer; records return values, every block write, drops, tile entity deltas, 3x3 chunk hashes and the Det digest per case.
notes: Output: manifest.json (kind place), shapes.bin, cases.bin, writes.bin, drops.bin, tileentities.bin, digest.txt.gz, start/end.txt, final.bin.gz, optional watch.bin.gz and at<N>.bin.gz. Uses Probe.rawChunks and Rows.writeListener. csrc/engine/place.h names it as its reference.
